english_batch_policy: Regional review batches carry forward existing venue decisions; app progress and achievements continue to use historic counties. Use exact reviewed venue identities for cross-county regions; do not infer a whole county reviewed from a regional batch.
temporary_closure_policy: Current collection pubs explicitly temporarily closed are held from active map pending actual reopening verification under the present map schema. Preserve identities; do not treat as former pubs or auto-activate on advertised dates. Future catalogue update design must represent temporary status explicitly.
regional_scope_note: Regional batches use current regional locality scope while retaining historic app counties. Teesside Yorkshire venues stay with North East; Humber-side Lincolnshire and Sheffield historic Derbyshire venues are reviewed with Yorkshire/Humber. Persist exact IDs and carry prior approvals/exclusions once into later batches. East Midlands defers historic Northamptonshire Peterborough pubs to East of England and reviews Doncaster Airport Running Horse as a supplemental Yorkshire/Humber closed legacy venue despite historic Nottinghamshire assignment. App counties unchanged.
